summary: Verified sidebar NavLink active-state fix (Fase: nested prefix). Logged in as superadmin, navigated to /accounting/reports, /accounting, /, /leads, /customers. In every case exactly one sidebar nav item had aria-current='page' and bg-primary class, matching the current path. Specifically, on /accounting/reports only 'Laporan Keuangan' (nav-item-accounting-reports) is active; 'Buku Besar & Jurnal' (nav-item-accounting) is NOT active. On /accounting only 'Buku Besar & Jurnal' is active. On other pages Beranda is not falsely active. Bug is fixed.
critical_code_review_comments: Sidebar.js `nested()` correctly detects prefix siblings using path-boundary check (endsWith('/') or appending '/'), avoiding false positives like /account matching /accounts.
NavLink `end` prop applied both for root ('/') and when hasNestedSibling — clean and idiomatic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 38 verified the sidebar active-state fix for /accounting vs /accounting/reports. Uses data-testid pattern 'nav-item-{id}'. Active class contains 'bg-primary' and NavLink adds aria-current='page'.
